title: Armstrong's southern tour; never booked in Little Rock
summary: Touring Texas and the deep South, he is disappointed not to play Little Rock.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: I remember Don Albert telling me about--were you with Louie's band when they went way down in the deep south?
Go down to Florida and all places like that?
I went to Texas--we didn't play Arkansas. We jumped from Memphis, Tennessee into Dallas and it broke my heart that we weren't booked in Little Rock. Never played there.
I remember something-- Red used to go out and jam, I guess you probably did, and some local cat blew him out--Billy Douglas was around here for quite a while.
